description: %redefine-const reads the constant's value before it: it extends a set with ∪, narrows it with ∩ or ∖, or replaces it (engine §2).
grammar:
%const $A B ∪ C
%redefine-const $A $A ∪ D
%const $N B ∪ C ∪ D
%redefine-const $N $N ∖ C
%redefine-const $N $N ∩ (B ∪ E)
%const $R B
%redefine-const $R E
%rule text $x(X)
%conditions $A = B ∪ C ∪ D, $N = B, $R = E
